speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the deserters' mill (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.deserters_mill).

nodes.text: A cairn by the burned mill, older than the mill by a thousand years. 'Armies pass. Stones stay.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
